load_multimodal_model: load a multimodal text-to-text model from Hugging Face for image or audio to text generation
export_image_text_model: export an image-text-to-text model like google/gemma-3-4b-it to ExecuTorch format
quantize_decoder_linears: quantize the decoder linear layers of a multimodal model using a qlinear config
quantize_encoder_embeddings: quantize the encoder embedding layers of a multimodal model with a specified group size
configure_generation_cache: configure a multimodal model with static KV cache and a maximum sequence length for generation
